caption:
One thought keeps circling: what if you don't make it? The fear of falling away runs on a loop — but what if finishing was never resting on you? (1 Thessalonians 5:8 devotional)

You hung your salvation on your own endurance, so every weak day loops back to "what if I fall away." But the helmet is the hope of salvation — not a maybe, a guaranteed finish set over the very thoughts where that fear lives. The One who began the good work in you has sworn to complete it; the finish line is secured by His faithfulness before you ever run it.
